title: DualPrompt general prompt with Mirror expert-prompt views
hypothesis: For aligned task-specific prompt residuals, a shared rank-two expert basis plus one per-task angle around a common general prompt retains explicit DualPrompt quality at fewer serialized bytes; it must beat hard expert sharing and the direct two-coefficient basis control.
physical_object: one task-invariant general prompt plus either an expert prompt bank or one shared rank-two expert basis
mirror_coordinate: one persisted FP16 angle m_j per retrieved task; expert_j = cos(m_j)u + sin(m_j)v

model.data: Synthetic binary classification with eight sequential task distributions. Inputs contain a noisy task-key vector and a Gaussian feature vector. Teacher decision functions share a task-invariant general component and have task residuals on a two-dimensional Givens orbit. Train, validation, and test examples are disjoint. Router prototypes are fitted from training key centroids, serialized as FP16, and used by every method at inference.

controls: DualPrompt-style independent general prompt plus per-task expert prompt bank
general prompt plus one hard-shared expert residual
general prompt plus shared rank-two expert basis with two direct coefficients per task
general prompt plus shared rank-two expert basis with one Mirror angle per task
development_gate_before_fresh: Both development worlds: explicit DualPrompt test accuracy >=0.85; Mirror within 0.02 absolute accuracy of explicit; Mirror actual serialized bytes <=0.65x explicit and <=1.10x direct coefficient basis; task-key retrieval >=0.98; Mirror mean final accuracy >=0.05 absolute over hard-shared expert residual. Report per-task accuracy, forgetting, training time, MAC estimate, and serialized-state throughput. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh worlds satisfy every quality, byte, retrieval, and retention gate; Mirror improves the quality-byte frontier over direct coefficient control; deterministic payload replay exact.
failure_gate: Any development seed misses a registered gate or direct coefficient control matches Mirror at comparable or lower bytes. Fresh remains sealed.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload
paid_objects: all expert prompts or shared expert basis

boundaries: no natural DualPrompt benchmark, image, or broad continual-learning claim
logical prompt count is not independent capacity
fresh seeds remain sealed unless the full development gate passes
